title: World's Greatest Couple
cn: 第27集 · 世界最佳情侣
novel:
Lily was [[crashing|crash]] on Ted and Marshall's couch, and she was [[desperate|desperate]] to feel like a [[functional|function]] human again. One night, she [[bumped|bump]] into Barney at a [[gallery|gallery]] opening. "What are you doing here?" she asked. "I'm here for the free [[champagne|champagne]]," he said. "Same," she admitted.

They fell into an easy [[rhythm|rhythm]] — going to events together, [[criticizing|criticize]] other people's [[relationships|relationship]], and pretending to be a [[couple|couple]] so they could get into [[exclusive|exclusive]] parties. "We're the world's greatest fake couple," Barney [[declared|declare]].

But when Barney's [[apartment|apartment]] was being [[fumigated|fumigate]], Lily invited him to stay at her [[sublet|sublet]]. In the middle of the night, Barney woke up in a [[panic|panic]]. "I think I have feelings," he [[gasped|gasp]]. Lily laughed so hard she nearly fell off the bed. "Barney, you don't have feelings. You have a [[spreadsheet|spreadsheet]] of women's names."

"But I do," he [[insisted|insist]]. "For who?" Lily asked. Barney paused. "For... you and Marshall. I want you two back together." Lily's smile [[faded|fade]]. "You actually care," she said.

"Don't tell anyone," Barney said. "I have a [[reputation|reputation]] to [[maintain|maintain]]."

crash.en: to stay at someone's place temporarily; to hit something violently

functional.en: working correctly and able to do what it's supposed to

bump into.en: to meet someone you know without planning to

gallery.en: a place where paintings and art are shown

champagne.en: an expensive French white wine with bubbles

rhythm.en: a regular pattern of sounds, movements, or events

criticize.en: to say what you think is bad about someone or something

relationship.en: the way two people feel and behave toward each other

exclusive.en: limited to a particular group; expensive and fashionable

apartment.en: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor

fumigate.en: to use chemicals to kill insects or infections in a building

sublet.en: an apartment rented from someone who is already renting it

panic.en: a sudden strong feeling of fear that stops clear thinking

gasp.en: to take a quick deep breath, especially from surprise or shock

spreadsheet.en: a computer file with rows and columns for organizing information

insist.en: to say firmly that something is true, even if others doubt it

fade.en: to slowly become weaker or disappear

reputation.en: what people generally think or say about someone

maintain.en: to keep something in good condition or continue having it
